description: Get the current Iași air quality summary from the iasi.io AQ endpoint. Also carries `data.pollen` — modeled pollen levels (CAMS via Open-Meteo) with per-species Romanian verdicts for alder (anin), birch (mesteacăn), grasses (graminee), mugwort (pelin), and ragweed (ambrozia). Pollen is a model estimate, not a local measurement (Iași has no pollen station), and the block is absent when its source is unreachable.
name: get_air_quality
